subject: Math
subskill: Compare or Relate Mean and Median
prompt:
$$62, 68, 71, 75, 79, 83, 87$$

The given list shows the daily high temperatures, in degrees Fahrenheit, recorded over $7$ days. Which of the following data sets has the same median as the given list?
explanation: Choice C is correct. The median of a data set is the middle value when the values are arranged in order. For a data set with $7$ values (an odd number), the median is the $4$th value when arranged in ascending order. The given list is already in order: $62, 68, 71, 75, 79, 83, 87$. Counting to the $4$th position gives $75$ as the median. Now checking each answer choice: Choice A has $4$th value $78$, Choice B has $4$th value $79$, Choice C has $4$th value $75$, and Choice D has $4$th value $73$. Only Choice C has the same median ($75$) as the given list.
